meta.name: Call of the Plaguebearer
meta.description: Player cards from the Call of the Plaguebearer campaign.
meta.author: Dr. Jack Science

cards.back_flavor: Peering through the barricades, you can spot several inexplicable devices and something that looks like a cadaver
cards.flavor: Was it your imagination, or did the corpse on the slab just twitch?
cards.name: Lab Delta
cards.text: [reaction] When you investigate this location: Increase its shroud level by 4 for this investigation. If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 3[per_investigator] clues, as a group, to put the set-aside Ripped Hallway location into play.

cards.flavor: While searching the case for something of value, you prick yourself on a needle within. You quickly pull your hand back, and find a glowing green liquid entering your veins. Your head spins, and your vision goes black for a moment. When you can see again, everything is tinged with a red haze. You feel an intense desire to break something, or someone. You can only hope that this anger will fade with time.
cards.name: Fire in the Veins
cards.text: - Record in your campaign log that "*your investigator* has injected a cardinal reagant". - Exile Suspicious Briefcase. Any investigator who has not "injected a cardinal reagant" may add it to their deck (Does not count towards deck size). That investigator immediately puts Suspicious Briefcase into play.

cards.flavor: The reagants carried within are oddly luminescent.
cards.name: Suspicious Briefcase
cards.text: [fast] Exhaust Suspicious Briefcase and reveal a random chaos token from the chaos bag: Gain 3 resources. If you revealed a [skull], [tablet], or [auto_fail], flip this card over and resolve its story text. Forced - If Suspicious Briefcase would leave play or you would be defeated: Exile Suspicious Briefcase.

cards.flavor: "We haveta look out for each other, eh friend?"
cards.name: Hibbs
cards.text:
You get +1 [willpower] and +1 [agility].
[reaction] When an investigator at your location would take an attack of opportunity, exhaust Hibbs: Cancel that attack.

cards.name: Herbert West
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect].
[reaction] When an enemy would be defeated at your location, exhaust Herbert West: Instead, heal 2 damage from that enemy. Then, discover 2 clues at your location.

cards.name: Death's Hold
cards.text: Revelation - Take 2 direct horror. This horror cannot be prevented.

cards.name: The Folly of Man
cards.text: Revelation - Take 2 direct damage. This damage cannot be prevented.

cards.name: Strength of Flesh
cards.text:
Permanent. Cannot leave play.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test where a [skull] token was revealed, exhaust Strength of Flesh: Heal all damage from Strength of Flesh.

cards.name: Unbreakable Will
cards.text:
Permanent. Cannot leave play.
[reaction] After you succeed at a skill test where a [cultist] token was revealed, exhaust Unbreakable Will: Heal all horror from Unbreakable Will.

cards.flavor: If it's worth doing, its worth overdoing.
cards.name: Excessive Spirits
cards.text: [reaction] After you succeed by 3 or more at a skill test during an action on your turn, exhaust Excessive Spirits: You may take an additional action this turn, which can only be used on the same type of action used to trigger this effect.

cards.name: Extended Loan
cards.text: Forced - When your turn begins: Place 2 resources (from the token pool) on this card. Resources on this card may be spent as if they were in your resource pool. Discard all resources from this card at the end of your turn.

cards.name: Handshake Deal
cards.text:
The first asset you play each round costs 1 fewer resource.
[action] Remove Handshake Deal from the game: Play an asset from your hand or discard pile, ignoring its resource cost.

cards.flavor: If you have Ma's thumbs up, all of Arkham's on your side.
cards.name: Ma's Approval
cards.text:
[reaction] When you play an [[Ally]] asset: Discard any cards attached to Ma's Approval and attach that asset to this card.
Attached asset takes up no [[Ally]] slots and gets +1 health and +1 sanity.

cards.flavor: "Now, I am lending you this on a purely provisional basis, you understand."
cards.name: Reliquary Tome
cards.text:
Your maximum hand size is increased by 4.
[action] Exhaust Reliquary Tome: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Ritual of Yaztaroth
cards.text: Forced - After Ritual of Yaztaroth enters play: Place 1 horror on it. [reaction] When you would spend a charge or secret on an asset you control, exhaust Ritual of Yaztaroth: Heal 1 horror from Ritual of Yaztaroth instead.

cards.name: Full Coverage
cards.text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
For the remainder of the round, each event you play gets -1 cost and gains "Draw 1 card." Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Hard Days Work
cards.text: You may only commit Hard Day's Work as an exact copy of any skill in your discard pile or as an exact copy of another card committed to this skill test, and it gains Hard Day's Work's icons in addition to its own.

cards.back_flavor: An unsettling glow, like light through water, comes from deeper in the Omega Wing...
cards.flavor: Something watches you through the window whenever you avert your gaze.
cards.name: The Left Artery
cards.text: Forced - After you start your turn at this location: Take 1 direct horror.

cards.name: Agent Greyson
cards.text:
You get +1 [intellect] and +1 [combat].
[reaction] After your turn ends, spend 1 resource: Move an investigator at your location to a connecting location.

cards.name: Messenger of the Flame
cards.text: Forced - At the start of the enemy phase, if Messenger of the Flame is at a Miasma location without horror: Defeat that location. Otherwise, move Messenger of the Flame once towards the nearest Miasma location without horror. [action] If it is not act 1, the investigators spend 3[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Parley. Out of desperation, you seek a bargain with Cthugha. Flip this card and resolve its story text.

cards.name: Feed the Flame
cards.text: text text
